notes.title: Demo bug fixes and balancing #1
notes.content:
Bugs fixed with this update


Fix private lobbies not being private

Overall collisions have been improved

Fix broken item spawns (unreachable or wrong spawns)

Voice chat delay should be lower

Fix loudness bar bad visualization / not accurate

Fix crouch bug for clients

Fix some stats not syncing correctly

Fix UI issues after loading

Added the implementation so you can escape out of the settings window in the lobby

Fix issue with playercount being wrong, making you unable to escape (let us know if it still happens, we have tested and it never happened for us)

Fix inventory bug with dropped item


Balancing


Increased kick range. Makes jackboxes a bit easier to kick

Jackbox speed has been lowered

Jester is less sensitive to voice (so you don't have to be scared to talk)

Increased player speed when down

Turned off collision of player with jackboxes so they can't trap you while downed



More bugs may be found and balancing is still an ongoing process for which we want your input! We hope you enjoy this patch that fixes some issues.



A positive review on the demo would help us out tremendously btw!



Discord Server

notes.title: Dev updates!! #1
notes.content:
Time for our first update!!
Hey everyone!

Time for our very first update — and we’re excited to finally share some behind-the-scenes progress with you all! From now on, we’ll be posting more regularly to keep you in the loop with what’s cooking over at the Fire Foot offices.

Please keep in mind: everything you see here is still a work-in-progress and might change by the time we launch!


Map Design / Layout
Level design is a huge part of what makes our game tick, and we've been pouring a lot of time into building a map that’s not just functional — but also fun and full of variety.

Think creepy corridors, mysterious rooms, and hidden nooks waiting to be explored. Here's a little peek at some of the areas we've been crafting!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/7fcb052bb16ff02e8e7c5aa321138392c8b807e7.gif"]
Puzzles
To shake up the core gameplay, we’ve been experimenting with light puzzle mechanics — adding a fresh twist without slowing things down.

Right now, they're still floating in a gloomy gray box world, but eventually, you'll find them cleverly tucked away inside the cursed castle...



A stepping sequence puzzle!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/29870f4e274b74f6192fcaa2bf96b3e873efb9e6.gif"]

A 'put these glowing stone objects in the right order' puzzle! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/69d725054bc93b1d269f965189bcf2b245bf7690.png"]
Skill games
We call them "skill games," but you can think of them as fast-paced, mini lockpicking challenges. These little trials keep things tense and test your reflexes in short bursts.



Quick time event - Nail the timing to unlock!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/a0c14dbe2dc3ed592f28c7d45501d2491880a28f.gif"]

Follow the zone - Stay in the sweet spot!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/c59784e486610390ea54672c910f71f5bebf64fa.gif"]

Right order - Hit the correct sequence to succeed!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582883/9efe6a7184d5b277447425536e49d4997566749d.png"]
Lobby chat & Steam setup
We've also been making progress on multiplayer features! That means:

Inviting Steam friends easily

Chatting with them in the lobby

Getting into matches together - fast and smooth

We're aiming to make playing with friends feel effortless.

Thanks for reading - and thanks for being here with us at the beginning of this journey. We can’t wait to show you more soon. If you have any questions or ideas, drop them in the comments - we’d love to hear from you!

- Team Fire Foot

notes.title: First month on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi there everyone!

Jester: A Foolish Ritual has officially been live on Steam for one month now, and we are so happy with the response! Thank you to everyone for wishlisting and following our progress. We are working hard to make this a fun experience for everyone!

We would love to share more of our development with all of you interested players! Listening to your feedback, playtesting early versions of the game... If that sounds interesting, be sure to join our Discord server!

Did you click on the link and see "Join Kick'n Hell's Discord server!"? That’s right — don’t worry, it’s not the wrong link. This is the server from our previous game, but we will update it in the future to provide information about our games separately.

Once again, thank you to everyone for showing interest in our game! If you haven’t wishlisted or followed us yet, please consider doing so — it really helps us out enormously!

- Team Fire Foot
